text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis. Based on your age, history of sun exposure, and the description of a rough, scaly plaque on your left dorsal hand that is asymptomatic, this is consistent with actinic keratosis. While the skin exam was largely unremarkable, this specific lesion requires monitoring due to its potential for malignant transformation into squamous cell carcinoma. I recommend avoiding direct sun exposure on that area and returning for a biopsy if the spot changes in size, color, or begins to bleed.
